notes: This programme is restricted admission ('Restricted admission Yes'). The DAAD page states 'Tuition fees per semester None' for this programme; the TH Köln semester contribution (approx. 352.70 EUR for winter semester 2026/2027) is an administrative/semester fee, not tuition, and is not entered as tuition. English proficiency can alternatively be proven by a B2 confirmation on the school-leaving certificate or by other certificates (TELC, ISE, UNIcert, PTE Academic) or a personal interview; German B1 can also be proven by other certificates listed on the page. The pre-semester application periods on the DAAD page ('Early April – 15 June' for applicants not mentioned in a) and the 'Application period: Early April - June 15, 2026' on the how-to-apply page do not state that they specifically apply to non-EU or foreign-qualification applicants, so no intake was included.

note.fr: Les candidats titulaires d'un diplôme étranger doivent lire les informations sur les conditions d'admission pour les diplômes internationaux. Vérifiez si votre Baccalauréat marocain est reconnu comme équivalent au 'Abitur' ou à la 'Fachhochschulreife'.
note.en: Applicants with a degree obtained outside Germany must read the information on admission requirements for international qualifications. Check whether your Moroccan Baccalauréat is recognised as equivalent to the 'Abitur' or 'Fachhochschulreife'.
